title: Oscairn control protocol 1: graph, sound management, parameters, transport and notifications
description: Complete JSON document. Byte/depth limits, duplicate-member rejection, finite double range, unique parameter addresses and queue semantics are specified in control-protocol.md.

directory.description: The patch's folder inside the library; empty for the library root

library.description: Asset library holding the patch's files (from assets.register or assets.import)

folder.description: Absolute folder path, used in place

file.description: Absolute path of a file to copy into the user library

value.description: Signed 64-bit decimal string; server enforces range.

PropertyValue.description: Strings/paths also have a 4096 UTF-8 byte limit and cannot contain NUL. Adapter packet limits may be smaller. Int requires an integer JSON token.

Wire.description: An RFC 0011 wire as graph.get reports it.

send.description: For a part's send wire, the bus it sends to; otherwise 0

fader.description: A part's wire to where it plays, carrying its level and mute

Part.description: An RFC 0011 part as graph.get reports it.

bus.description: The bus it plays through instead of its output port, or 0

Zone.description: A note zone (RFC 0011): notes in its key, velocity and MIDI channel ranges pass, transposed and with velocity out = in^curve, or a fixed velocity above 0.

channel.description: -1: the channel the player is on

PadMap.description: Which note each pad plays: eight banks (A..H) of 16 pads from the bottom-left, row by row.

Scene.description: A scene: each part's fader and each scene parameter's value.
